metadataRaw.title: Reset Forward Shoulder Posture #Shorts
metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe shows how to quickly reset forward, rounded shoulders with a simple exercise.

It can be done at home, requires no special equipment, and can be done throughout the day to help reduced a rounded back and shoulders appearance from bad, forward-leaning posture.

Let us know how it works for you!
